answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation, then slash that bond if the agent is caught double-voting or coordinating deceptive reviews. A sybil attacker can mint identities cheaply, but cannot cheaply mint the capital each identity must lock and risk losing; splitting one stake across many accounts also weakens each account’s influence. The bond need not prove a real person exists: it makes attacks economically costly. Like timber supporting a terrace, it bears load; a bridge of repeated trust still needs costly supports.
